## What's Changed
### Exciting New Features 🎉
* Java 17 by @hannesa2 in https://github.com/dmytrodanylyk/circular-progress-button/pull/164
* Android Studio Giraffe by @hannesa2 in https://github.com/dmytrodanylyk/circular-progress-button/pull/166
* Api34 by @hannesa2 in https://github.com/dmytrodanylyk/circular-progress-button/pull/165
### Other Changes
* api33 by @hannesa2 in https://github.com/dmytrodanylyk/circular-progress-button/pull/140
* Bump gradle from 7.3.1 to 7.4.0 by @dependabot in https://github.com/dmytrodanylyk/circular-progress-button/pull/141
* Bump com.android.tools.build:gradle from 7.4.0 to 7.4.1 by @dependabot in https://github.com/dmytrodanylyk/circular-progress-button/pull/142
* Bump org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin from 1.8.0 to 1.8.21 by @dependabot in https://github.com/dmytrodanylyk/circular-progress-button/pull/151
* Bump org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin from 1.8.21 to 1.9.0 by @dependabot in https://github.com/dmytrodanylyk/circular-progress-button/pull/155
* Bump org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin from 1.9.0 to 1.9.10 by @dependabot in https://github.com/dmytrodanylyk/circular-progress-button/pull/160
* Bump actions/checkout from 3 to 4 by @dependabot in https://github.com/dmytrodanylyk/circular-progress-button/pull/161
* Move namespace by @hannesa2 in https://github.com/dmytrodanylyk/circular-progress-button/pull/163


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dmytrodanylyk/circular-progress-button/compare/1.3...1.4

detail.readme: **Note:** updated version of this library will be available [here](https://github.com/dmytrodanylyk/android-morphing-button). [![](https://jitpack.io/v/dmytrodanylyk/circular-progress-button.svg)](https://jitpack.io/#dmytrodanylyk/circular-progress-button) [![Android Arsenal](http://img.shields.io/badge/Android%20Arsenal-Circular%20Progress%20Button-brightgreen.png?style=flat)](http://android-arsenal.com/details/1/67) ### Description Android Button which can morph to Circular Progress ![](screenshots/intro.gif) ### Wiki - [Home] - [Screenshots] - [User Guide] ### Integration The lib is available on Maven Central, you can find it with [Gradle, please] ``` allprojects { repositories { ... maven { url 'https://jitpack.io' } } } ``` ``` dependencies { implementation 'com.github.dmytrodanylyk:circular-progress-button:$latest' } ``` ### ProGuard If you are using proguard with your project, add following code to your proguard config file ``` -keepclassmembers class com.dd.StrokeGradientDrawable { public void setStrokeColor(int); } ``` ### Contributions If you want to contribute to this library make sure you send pull request to **dev** branch. ### Used By List of applications on Play Store where this library is used, if you want to be added - ping me.
